title: Procedural Sneaker Customizer
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with a procedural sneaker customizer using Three.js. Load the model 'Corset.glb' using GLTFLoader from a CDN (use https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js). The corset model serves as the base shoe/sneaker form that users can customize.

SCENE SETUP:
- Set up a Three.js scene with a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 1.5, 3) looking at origin.
- Add a white ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light at (5, 5, 5) with intensity 1.0 and castShadow enabled.
- Use OrbitControls for camera rotation (import from CDN). Restrict polar angle between 0.2 and Math.PI/2 to prevent going below ground.
- Add a circular ground plane (radius 3, color #222222) at y=0 with receiveShadow.
- Set renderer background to #1a1a2e. Enable shadows on the renderer.
- Load Corset.glb, scale it to (8, 8, 8), and position it at (0, 0.5, 0). Center it on the ground plane.

CUSTOMIZATION FEATURES:
1. COLOR ZONES: The sneaker model has multiple mesh children. Assign each mesh child a default MeshStandardMaterial. Track 3 color zones: 'sole' (first mesh child), 'upper' (second mesh child or remaining children), 'accent' (last mesh child). Default colors: sole=#ffffff, upper=#2196F3, accent=#FF5722.
2. MATERIAL TYPE: Support 3 material presets - 'matte' (roughness:0.9, metalness:0.1), 'glossy' (roughness:0.2, metalness:0.3), 'metallic' (roughness:0.3, metalness:0.9). Default is 'matte'.
3. ROTATION TURNTABLE: A toggle button to auto-rotate the model at 0.5 radians/sec around Y axis.

UI PANEL (DOM):
- Create a fixed panel on the left side (width 280px, background rgba(0,0,0,0.85), padding 20px, color white, font-family Arial).
- Title: 'SNEAKER STUDIO' in bold, 24px.
- Section 'Color Zones' with 3 color input pickers: id='color-sole', id='color-upper', id='color-accent' with labels.
- Section 'Material' with 3 buttons: id='btn-matte', id='btn-glossy', id='btn-metallic'. Highlight the active one with a border (2px solid #00ff88).
- Section 'View' with a toggle button id='btn-turntable' that says 'Turntable: OFF' / 'Turntable: ON'.
- A 'Reset' button id='btn-reset' that resets all customizations to defaults.
- Display current rotation angle (degrees, integer) in a span id='rotation-display'.

STATE MANAGEMENT:
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- modelLoaded: boolean, true once Corset.glb is loaded
- soleColor: string hex like '#ffffff'
- upperColor: string hex like '#2196F3'
- accentColor: string hex like '#FF5722'
- materialType: string ('matte'|'glossy'|'metallic')
- turntableActive: boolean (default false)
- rotationY: number (current Y rotation of model in radians)
- meshCount: number (number of mesh children found in loaded model)
- cameraDistance: number (distance from camera to origin)
- roughness: number (current roughness value)
- metalness: number (current metalness value)

Update __3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop. When color pickers change, immediately update the corresponding mesh materials and __3D_STATE__. When material buttons are clicked, update all meshes and state. When turntable is toggled, update state and button text.

PHYSICS/ANIMATION:
- When turntable is active, rotate model by 0.5 * delta radians per frame around Y.
- Ensure rotationY stays in [0, 2*PI) range using modulo.
- Camera distance should always be positive and finite.
physics_constraints: Model rotation must be continuous and bounded in [0, 2π). Camera distance must remain positive and finite. Material property values must stay in valid [0,1] range. All color values must be valid hex strings.
